senses.gloss: पू vt. 1Ā, 4Ā, 9U (pp. पूत; pres. पवते, पूयते, पुनाति, पुनीते; caus. पावयति; desid. पिपविषति) 1. To make pure, to purify, to sanctify, पुण्याश्रमदर्शनेन तावदात्मानं पुनीमहे Sak.i., R.i.53, Bt.vi.64; 2. to clean from chaff, to winnow; 3. to discriminate, to discern; 4. to invent, to think out, to contrive.
